label: sec:co-computation-intro
html: Carbon monoxide is the first heteronuclear test of the template. Carbon monoxide CO as a molecular braid joins the (6,6) carbon braid to the (8,8) oxygen braid with three shared electron pairs on a common strand set. The LP dual selects the triple bond as optimal for CO. We extract the CO triple bond energy from the Wedderburn invariants. Heteronuclear bonding requires no new machinery, only the asymmetric strand counts of the two atomic factors.
